shared_elements: massive monolithic stone block carved in low relief
broad upper section (head/top) set over a narrower body
circular disc or ring motif on the body
carved arms/limbs converging toward the front centre
animal or creature figures rendered in shallow relief
justification: Both are monumental upright stone blocks with a wider top section over a narrower body, and both carry a prominent circular disc or ring plus a horizontal banded belt crossing the mid-body, with limbs in shallow relief converging toward the front centre. The rendering differs markedly, however: A is a rounded, volumetric sculpture whose relief is soft, worn and integrated into a three-dimensional figure, while B is a flat-faced slab bearing crisp, linear, register-like relief of distinct animal figures, so the resemblance is largely structural rather than stylistic.
